evidence.name: Screen field: Title look and spacing
evidence.userNeed: Know what "Title look and spacing" controls and when to adjust it while editing a screen.

sections.title: Title look and spacing
sections.description: Open this to override how the carousel's headline looks: font size, weight, color, alignment, and the padding around the text. It only shows when the template includes a title. Leave it untouched to inherit your theme so screens stay consistent; change it only when one carousel needs a bigger or bolder headline, and note the overrides apply to the title on every slide.
